_comment: Template clip musical SOTA 2026 — Kling v3 multi-shot (6 shots × 15s) + BPM-sync + lipsync moments clés
_workflow: nano-banana-pro → Kling v3 multi-shot 15s → LatentSync → Shotstack BPM-cut → MP4

requests.prompt: Atmospheric wide establishing shot, dark concert stage with dramatic spotlight, fog machine, cinematic, ultra detailed
multiShotPrompts: Extreme wide shot — dark stage emerges from black, spotlight cuts through fog, slow cinematic push in, ultra quality
Stage fills frame — fog swirls around performer silhouette, camera drifts left, dramatic atmospheric lighting
Low angle wide shot looking up at stage light array, beams cutting through smoke, cinematic lens flare
Aerial drift down toward stage, crowd blur in foreground, hero silhouette under single spotlight, epic scale

requests.prompt: Extreme close-up portrait of [ARTISTE], dramatic side lighting, dark background, intense gaze, cinematic film grain, high contrast
multiShotPrompts: ECU — eyes closed, face still, side-lit by warm amber, camera holds, breath visible
Eyes slowly open, direct gaze to camera, slight jaw tension, light shifts cold to warm
Profile close-up — jaw line, ear, neck tension, camera circles slowly, dark cinematic
Full face close-up — intense expression, lips moving, dramatic rim lighting, film grain
ECU lips — precise lip movement, warm key light, dark background, ultra sharp
Pull back slightly to tight close-up, face fills frame, emotional peak expression

requests.prompt: [ARTISTE] medium shot, performing on stage, dark moody atmosphere, dramatic backlighting, cinematic
multiShotPrompts: Medium shot — performer centered, backlit silhouette, slow zoom in, smoke around feet
Three-quarter angle — performer turns slightly, hand gesture, dramatic side light
Waist-up shot — stage background blurs, performer sharpens, camera pushes forward
Medium close-up — upper body, microphone in hand, sweat glistens under stage light

Side view hands + mic stand, fog drifting past, atmospheric stage light
ECU mouth close to mic, breath fog, rim-lit lips, extreme slow motion
Wide knuckles shot — fingers tense, veins visible, single warm spotlight

multiShotPrompts: Tight close-up — performer singing, full emotional commitment, cold dramatic lighting
ECU — eyes intense, lips moving with power, light flares across face

Final wide — full reveal of stage scale, crowd in silhouette, peak dramatic moment
